name: pixel-art-game-opus
description: The Hourglass City: an isometric noir adventure and a real-time car-chase test level, in plain JavaScript and Canvas 2D

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p src/jsconfig.json && tsc -p src_test/jsconfig.json && tsc -p src_garden/jsconfig.json
scripts.test:city: node tools/play.js routeA && node tools/play.js routeB && node tools/kb.js && node tools/run.js tests/city_exits.json && node tools/run.js tests/city_entry_probe.json
scripts.test:level: node tools/tl.js tests/level_playthrough.json && node tools/tl.js tests/level_interactions.json && node tools/tl.js tests/level_menus_tram.json
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:city && npm run test:level
